name: Anomalía de Corte de Escena
description: Detecta anomalías en cortes de escena que indican manipulación
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Scene Cut Anomaly Detection
mechanism:
This method detects scene cut anomalies for video forensic analysis:

1. **Scene Cut Detección**: Scene cuts (hard cuts, dissolves, fades, wipes) are detected by analyzing inter-frame similarity metrics — histogram differences, pixel MSE, and structural similarity. Cut locations are identified and classified by type.

2. **Cut Point Content Análisis**: The content immediately before and after each cut is analyzed for consistency. Manipulated videos may contain cuts specifically placed to hide temporal discontinuities from deepfake insertion — cuts at moments where generation artifacts would be most visible.

3. **Cut Frecuencia Análisis**: The temporal distribution of cuts is analyzed. Normal video editing follows content-driven patterns (cuts at speech pauses, action changes). Anomalous cut frequency — particularly rapid cuts correlating with challenging deepfake scenarios (profile views, extreme expressions) — may indicate editing to conceal generation failures.

4. **Cross - Cut Consistencia**: Content properties (lighting, color balance, noise level) should be consistent across cuts within the same scene. The method checks for property discontinuities at cuts that might indicate different source material. Face properties changing at cut points (subtle identity shifts, quality changes) suggest manipulation.

5. **Cut - Compresión Alignment**: In properly encoded video, scene cuts should align with I-frame positions. Misalignment between detected cuts and I-frames may indicate post-manipulation re-encoding without proper scene detection, a forensic trace of manipulation processing.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
